title: Connected-Diagram Expansions for Hermite–Jensen Multipliers: All-Excess Summation and Critical Zero Asymptotics
author: Wanzheng Ning
summary: A single-author manuscript on connected-diagram expansions for Hermite–Jensen multipliers, all-excess summation, and critical zero asymptotics. It was submitted to Advances in Mathematics on 31 August 2026 and is currently under review.
accessText: The manuscript and private submission materials are not publicly available while the article is under review because the current submission agreement restricts public sharing.
